definition: The scoring system Australia's skilled visa routes, including the Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189), use to rank candidates on factors such as age, English ability, skilled employment history, and qualifications.
longform: Meeting the minimum points score makes a candidate eligible to be considered — it does not by itself guarantee an invitation, since invitations are generally issued to the highest-scoring candidates within an occupation up to whatever number the programme has room for in a given round. A score comfortably above the stated minimum is a meaningfully stronger position than one that just clears it.
